verdict.rationale: Forter's architecture (Order API, webhooks, dispute forwarding) is explicitly PSP-agnostic — merchants 'integrate your PSP with Forter' generically, and named integrations include Stripe (dispute webhooks, PaymentIntent mapping) and Shopify (turnkey quickstart), suggesting broad payment-stack compatibility rather than lock-in to one processor. However, the evidence pack only concretely documents two integrations (Stripe, Shopify) and never enumerates support across multiple gateways/PSPs/platforms as a first-class capability. Missing for 10: an explicit list/matrix of supported PSPs and gateways beyond Stripe, documentation of platform-agnostic setup for non-Shopify e-commerce stacks, and independent confirmation of multi-PSP usage in production.
